name: NERVE CATHEDRAL: Neural-Sync Dance & Social Venue
description: A large-format neural-sync dance venue operating in a converted Tier 2 industrial cathedral space, running curated collective dance sessions where participants' BCI feeds are loosely synchronized through a shared emotional frequency layer — not full neural merge, but a low-level resonance that makes the crowd's emotional state mutually legible and gently amplifying. The architecture is designed for it: tiered balconies for observers, a central floor for full-sync participants, and isolation alcoves for people who want proximity without connection. House Architects manage the collective emotional state in real time, preventing cascade spikes.
story_hooks: Someone has been attending NERVE CATHEDRAL with a modified BCI that introduces specific emotional signals into the collective resonance layer — signals that correlate with increased susceptibility to suggestion in the hours following a session.

A House Architect has been secretly recording the aggregate emotional state data from every session, building a longitudinal map of Tier 2 community emotional health that someone very powerful wants to acquire.

The venue's founding collective has received an anonymous offer to purchase the building — an offer so far above market value that refusing it seems irrational, and accepting it would end the only genuinely independent large social space left in the district.
